title: Pin file
description: The machine-readable definition of docs/PIPELINE-CONTRACT.md §3 — the dispatcher-written binding of one session to one ticket, at <dispatch.pinsRoot>/<sha256(realpath(session root))[:16]>.json. Written OUTSIDE every worktree, before the session starts, by the dispatcher only; deleted by the dispatcher at session end. Nothing a session can write may ever be substituted for it.
$comment: SHAPE ONLY. A schema cannot tell that `worktree` is the session root the reader derived, that `expires_at` is still in the future, or that `ticket` is present because `session_mode` is `ticket` — all three are semantic and all three are MUSTs in §3's read protocol. Conformance here is the floor, not the check.

pin_version.description: 1. An unrecognized value means the reader refuses; it does not guess.

dispatch_id.description: Opaque, unique per dispatch. Joins the pin to runs.run_id (§4) and to ledger.jsonl.

session_mode.description: What this session is allowed to be. Fixes which `stage` values its telemetry may report (§4).

worktree.description: Absolute path to the worktree this pin governs. A reader MUST verify it matches the session root it derived; a mismatch is a hard stop, not a warning (§3).

branch.description: Expected branch. Lowercased throughout — the live guard is [a-z0-9-] only, so feat/ENG-123-… is blocked before the first edit (§1).

auth_mode.description: Copied from delivery.json → auth for the lane that dispatched.

budget.description: The resolved caps for this run — ALREADY clamped against budgets.maxTurns. attempt/of carry the totalAttempts position from the dispatcher state record (§9).

ticket.description: Required when session_mode is `ticket`; may be null otherwise. That conditional is semantic — a reader checks it, this schema cannot.

id.description: e.g. ENG-123. Uppercase team key; the BRANCH lowercases it.

state_id.description: The Linear workflow-state ID, never the display name (§1).

effort.description: From the effort:* label; selects budgets.perEffort.

track.description: From the track:* label (§6). NULL when the ticket carried none — the same 'there is no value here' idiom this schema already uses for subject and ticket, and a faithful snapshot beats an invented default. A ticket without a track:* label is a Definition-of-Ready failure the gate is supposed to have caught (§7); the pin records that it happened rather than papering over it.

provenance.description: The FULL value including the epic ID (§5 rule 4) — the label carries only the class. Guards match this, not the label.

acceptance_criteria.description: The definition of done, snapshotted at dispatch. Parsed from the ticket's `## Acceptance criteria` section with the task-list marker stripped. A missing or empty section yields an EMPTY list — never an inferred one (§3).

out_of_scope.description: Explicit non-goals — the scope fence. Parsed from `## Out of scope`. Empty means the ticket shipped without one (§3).

snapshot_at.description: When the ticket was read. The pin is a snapshot: later edits do not reach a running session.

subject.description: Free-text subject for non-ticket modes. Null for `ticket` mode.

pinned_by.description: Provenance of the pin itself, e.g. dispatcher:runner-01.

expires_at.description: Past it the pin is stale; readers treat it as ABSENT and a sweeper deletes it. Absence never grants autonomy (§3).

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC with a literal Z. Not a local offset — one timezone across the whole pipeline.

branchName.description: The live PreToolUse branch-naming guard's own pattern.
